text: Dendir Abbathorson was a dwarf adventurer and thief who was part of the Ruby Blades adventuring company in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Lord Dermod Ophal was an Amnian nobleman who lived in the City of Coin, Athkatla during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Deena was a dryad who lived in the Hullack Forest in the 14 century DR.
Derg was a cowardly orc who served red dragon Firkraag in his maze in the Windspear Hills of Amn in the late 14 century DR.
Deirdre Gallaway was running the Gallaway Trade Depot in Targos, in the early 14 century DR.
Delmath was an acquaintance of several guards in Shadowdale in the mid-14 century DR.
Reverend Brother Harvestmaster Derim Whiteshield was a priest of Chauntea inhabiting Mistledale in the Dalelands during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Denzil Lassar, later known as Lady D, was the owner and the founder of the Inferno Hall, a temple to Sharess of Ravens Bluff in the late 14 century DR.
Densil Wizardfoe was an adventurer in Cormyr with the Magebanes company in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Delmar was a spy of the Purple Dragon Knights in Eveningstar during the mid-14 century DR.
King Derek Parhek "the Drunkard" was the second Amnian monarch of the Parhek dynasty.
Lord Derrick Lurian was a noble of House Lurian in the city of Procampur in the Vast in the late 14 century DR.
Dennon Nosmile was a legendary halfling and a cautionary tale who lived sometime before the late 15 century DR.
Derque Rillyn was a member of the noble patriar Rillyn family of Baldur's Gate, daughter of Hir Rillyn, and cousin of Clerebold in the late 15 century DR.
Degliangeli was a Netherese bard who lived in Eileanar until its destruction in .
Delon was a child messenger from the village of Imnesvale in the Umar Hills of Amn in the late 14 century DR.
Denneth Rhardantan was a man from Mistledale in the late 15 century DR.
Delnor was a palace messenger in Suzail, during the late 15 century DR.
Delcan was a laborer and a delivery man of the Baldur's Mouth Gazette in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.

Dedryk Black was a notorious Sharran who long lived within the Wheloon Prison, and became the priestly leader of a Sharran cult that operated from a hideout in the Storm Horns foothills of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Dellys was a news hawker who worked for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Derevon Ybir was a human resident of Eveningstar in Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Deepbeak was a subterranean owlbear that lived beneath Myth Drannor in the late 14 century DR.
Deric, sometimes called Deric of the Ffolk, was a chieftain of the Ffolk people of the Moonshae Isles and the first King of Corwell in the mid–2 century DR.
Delethir Mistveil was a healer who worked at the Eveningstar War Hospital during the late 15 century DR.
Delyarna a wealthy citizen of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Delsaran was a Mystra-worshiping elf of the High Forest in the 3 century DR.
Brother Dectaran was a servant of the Silver Flame in the world of Eberron.
Delgod was a hunting companion of Sendai Argrim, an Amnish noblewoman from Nashkel in the mid-14 century DR.
Delvar Demonee was a human shopkeeper living in the city of Ravens Bluff in the mid-14 century DR. He was the proprietor of a shop that dealt in both tailoring and footwear.

Denia Vesdar was a spy for the Zhentarim, who worked in the Tower of the Blades in the city of Mulmaster. She had attained her rank after proving herself time and again, beginning her career as a mere soldier within Zhentil Keep.
Deep Sashelas () was an elven deity who made his home on Arvandor, although he was rumored to maintain a demesne off the coast of the Moonshae Isles known as Tír faoi Thoinn.
Dediana Extaminos was the yuan-ti halfblood ruler of the city of Hlondeth in 1372 DR.
Grand Civilar Derek Windsfire was one of the high commanders of the City Watch of Waterdeep.

Delamartina Illance was a member of the Illance noble family of Cormyr. She was very beautiful and rumored to have had four royal bastards, whom Vangerdahast found homes for. She was the grandmother of Martin Illance, who was named for her.

Deudermont was a sea captain and commander of the famous Sea Sprite, a large pirate-hunting vessel commissioned to him by the Lords of Waterdeep, in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. He was briefly governor of the city of Luskan during its rebellion. He was also a friend of Drizzt and the Companions of the Hall.
Dhaerivus was a human wizard with dark eyes and a thin white face.
Lord Dimswart was one of the leading sages in service to the royalty of Cormyr in Suzail.

Lord Dhelt was a human man of the city of Elturel in the Western Heartlands in the mid–14 century DR. He was a cavalier and later paladin of Helm, a former leader of the Hellriders, and the ruling High Rider of Elturel. He reigned from the High Hall.

Dinosaurs, also known as thunderers, behemoths ( ), or garuda, were a group of ancient reptilian creatures found on Toril. They were considered agents and children of the Chultan deity Ubtao, though some of them had turned rogue to serve his enemy Eshowdow. Some instead claimed they were created by the Giant creator deity Annam All-Father to populate the early world.
Desther Indelayne was a cleric in the service of Maugrim in 1372 DR.
Dharjamyn Thauntle was a cobbler who operated Thauntle's Good Heels and Soles in the South Ward of Waterdeep.
Dhoelath was an elven high mage who lived in his tower, Dhoelath's Tower, in Leuthilspar on Evermeet.
Dimon was a cleric of Bane and the tharchion of Tyraturos in the realm of Thay in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dhelosk Quelbeard was the owner of The Blackbutter Inn in Red Larch. Dhelosk was a thin, laconic man from southern Amn who was always interested in news from afar.
The desert dwarves, also known as the Hairy Men of the Desert by Mazticans, were dwarves who lived in the deserts south of Kultaka and Nexal on the continent of Maztica.
Deskyr Thanterim was the son of Hersir Thanterim and was the only member of the Thanterim family still alive by 1479.
Desert giants were once numerous Zakharan giants. Since the decline of their civilization, they were mostly shepherds often traveling with their cattle herds across deserts.

Dier Ashlin was a male human Zhentilar soldier during the Time of Troubles in 1358 DR. He was guarding the Temple of Bane in Zhentil Keep when the god Bane himself, in the corpse of Fzoul Chembryl, arrived in the city after the disastrous Battle of Shadowdale. Ashlin, believing he was speaking to Fzoul, explained the change in the city's government after the defeat.

Dietr was a halfling soul residing in the halfling sphere of heaven, the Green Fields in 1372. During his second confrontation with the lichdrow Lord Dyrr, the Archmage of Menzoberranzan, Gromph Baenre, was physically sent by his enemy to the Green Fields. Here, Gromph met Dietr, who was enjoying his afterlife. However, after meeting with a living being, Dietr was reminded of his mortal life and his loved ones who remained in the Realms, especially his mother in Luiren. So, when Gromph went back to Toril, Dietr followed him. However, arriving in the Menzoberranzan Bazaar, Dietr, having abandoned the heaven, became a huecuva. Gromph felt no sympathy for Dietr and forced him to go up against t
Dessa sik-Morcane was a female drow cleric of Lolth in Szith Morcane who, during the Silence of Lolth, turned to barbarism.
Dhamir Ercaln was the high priest of Cyric in Darkhold and one of the Zhentarim leaders of the fortress in the Year of the Tankard, 1370 DR.
Diinakvil Rylafyrn was the leader of the derro Council of Savants of Gracklstugh in 1370 DR and 1372 DR.
Dinnom Baraizal was one of the ten Cloakmasters of Athkatla for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR.

Dillard Portyr () was the leading Grand Duke of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR. He later ceded the title of Grand Duke to Ulder Ravengard following recent disturbances in the city and continued to serve as a Duke as part of the Council of Four.
The Destroyer, or He Who Learns to Destroy, was a yak-man who lived beneath Huzuz in the Lair of the Unspeakable in 1367 DR.

Diancastra was the giant demigoddess of wit and pleasure, a minor trickster deity of the Ordning. A goddess of many faces, Diancastra won her place among the giant pantheon through her daring, craftiness, and carousing ways.
Derval Ironeater was the last King of Clan Ironeater who went on to become a blacksmith in Daggerford.
Dheren Ogresbane was one of the Swords of Archendale in 1368 DR.
Dinam was a member of the Dukars of Myth Nantar in Serôs in 1370 DR.
Dimian Ree was the 27 Baron of Morov in the Kingdom of Damara, and ruled in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. He was the de facto ruler of the kingdom's largest city and central trade hub, Heliogabalus.
Dhalmass Rayburton was a member of House Rayburton, and the only non-Tabaxi member of the barae, the seven "super-paladins" sworn to protect the holy city of Mezro in Chult.
King Desharik was a pirate lord of the Sea of Swords and the ruler of Brynnlaw.

Diloule "Lanternhand" was a human thief and a member of the adventuring company known as The Four. He was hanged as an assassin in Tethyr on the day before Higharvestide in 1369 DR following the siege of Myratma, along with fellow members Telorn and Fiirfar Nulomn.
Diaytha was a drow priestess who acted under the orders of the Bhaalspawn Sendai.
Desedrak was an officer serving within the Flaming Fist mercenary company during the mid–14 century DR.

Dickon Sharken was a skilled mercenary who lived in the city of Pyarados in Thay during the mid-14 century DR. He nearly reported observations of his varied encounters to the region's tharchion, Valerios Theokillos.
High Moonmistress Dhauna Myritar was the high priestess of Selûne at Moonshadow Hall, in the city of Yhaunn in the mid-to-late 14 century.
Devlin Taralon was a ranged weapons dealer and slave of Baeloth Barrityl.
Destus Gurn was a member of the Baldur's Gate branch of the Iron Throne during the mid-to-late 14 century DR. He served as the assistant Chief Accountant for all operations in the Sword Coast.
Dire apes, a type of dire animal, were a breed of unusually large and aggressive ape.
Dillsandra was a young girl living in Easthaven during the 11th century DR.
Diane Halistinar was an inhabitant of Hillsfar and former priest of Sune around 1367 DR.
Deryk Stoneshaper was a dwarven warrior and stone mason who inhabitaned Phlan around 1367 DR.
Desert cyclops were large humanoids native to Zakhara distinguished by their single eye.
Diaboli (singular: Diabolus) were a race of people native to the Demiplane of Nightmares, where they filled the same niche humans did on the Material Plane.
Devlin Patchwerk was a member of the Shadow Thieves and brother of Mishad Patchwerk who resided in the stronghold within Undermountain in the mid–14 century DR.
Devana Melshimber, formerly Devana Perrentine of Tilverton, was a noblewoman who married into the Melshimber noble family of Waterdeep in 1370 DR.
Dharmun was a woodcutter who worked on the project to build a canal that connected the Lake of Steam to the Nagaflow in the 1360s DR.
Diccon Picard was a jeweler of the town of Ghars in Cormyr in the mid–14 century DR.
Sheikh Didaji was a leader of one of the Bedine tribes that lived in Anauroch during the mid–14 century DR.
Devuri was a crayfish hengeyokai shukenja and priest of the Lords of Creation in the town of Kataburi in the Kuong Kingdom in the mid–14 century DR. He was previously an adventurer.
Lord Dimarond was the last general of Imaskar during the fall of the Empire.
Dimble was a rock gnome living in Gnomengarde in the late 15 century DR.
Dessra of the Dark Desires was a famous courtesan at the Purple Palace festhall in the Dock Ward of Waterdeep in the mid-1360s DR.
Hierophant Dezelyna Goldeagle was a Chultan druid inhabiting the Chultan Peninsula in 1372 DR.
Dilby was a commoner from the town of Nashkel in Amn in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dhurthal Ironhand was a blacksmith and "Master Armorer" who lived in the village of Eveningstar during the late 14 century DR.

Dexon was a Vaasan warrior that joined several of his countrymen on an expedition to the city of Evereska in the late 14 century DR. There they reunited with Melegaunt Tanthul, an ally of their ancestors who led them to a series of events that would reshape the face of Faerûn for decades to follow.
Brother Dervarr was a priest of Chauntea inhabiting Immilmar in Rashemen during the late 14 century DR.
Dienje Xavarri was a priestess of Iyachtu Xvim active in the Thayan city of Bezantur in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Dilthari was one of the Empyrean Knights stationed in Stardeep. She accompanied the Keeper of the Cerulean Sign Telarian in during the outriding into the Underdungeon of Stardeep, looking for a different passage into Sildëyuir; while investigating a skeleton on a ruby throne atop a pile of petrified bodies, she was attacked by the suddenly animating relic lich. She died instantly, and her body fossilized before it hit the ground.

Dharvanum was one of the Empyrean Knights until . After the Keeper of the Cerulean Sign Telarian struck Commander Brathtar down, he promoted Dharvanum to the position. Nearly immediately, Dharvanum judged the Keeper's reason had deserted him and that he had to be struck down. Telarian slew him just as immediately. A gore splash was left behind where he was struck down, which Telarian had to explain later.
Dexam was a capricious beholder ally of Fzoul Chembryl of the Zhentarim in the mid-14 century DR.
Dherk was the leader of the Razorhides in the late 14 century DR.
Dhimar was a worshiper and former high priest of Myrkul in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dierdre was a barmaid inhabiting the city of Zhentil Keep during the mid–14 century DR.
Desmodu were a species of large, subterranean humanoids related to bats.
Din Caldwell was a member of the Caldwell patriar family of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Diana Cloppington was an individual who worked at the Witchlight Carnival as a ticket-taker for the carousel.
Dida was an apprentice blacksmith who worked in Moonhaven sometime during or before the late 15 century DR. She studied under the guidance of the town's more expert smith, Sampson.
Sapper Dextor was a goblin follower of the Absolute who dwelled within the Shattered Sanctum during the late 15 century DR.
The woman only known as Dimples was a city guard of Westgate and an aspiring dancer in the late 14 century DR.
Diero Mivaldi was a trader who operated in the Sea of Fallen Stars in the late 14 century DR.
Deslima, nicknamed Sneaker, was a shu warrior of the Jengi tribe who lived on the Malatran Plateau on the shores of the Lake of Giant Flies in the late 14 century DR.
Deverel Rinthar was a mageling of the Zhentarim in the mid-14 century DR.
Diores the Charming was a musician of some renown who lived sometime during or before the late 15 century DR.
King Dhanar Parhek was the fourth and final Amnian monarch of the Parhek dynasty.
Diophant was a Netherese arcanist who worked as a moneychanger in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in . He took fees of about 6–15% on each transaction.
Dilgar Sneese was a worshiper of Umberlee who prayed at the Water Queen's House in Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Digby was a no-good trapper, brother to Doogal and Dolan, from the town of Lonelywood in Icewind Dale in the late 13 century DR.
Diomira Trellis was an Untaken of Umberlee, a low-ranking member of the Bitch Queen's clergy under Flood Tide Allandra Grey of the Water Queen's House in Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Devella Fountainhead was a Constable and a paladin of the Flaming Fist who served the city of Baldur's Gate in late 15 century DR.
Dessafon was a yuan-ti abomination that led a cell of yuan-ti rebels near the High Road of Cormyr during the late 15 century DR.
Dhag Greybeard was the Herald of both High Horn keep and the town of Waymoot in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dharin Brislen was the husband to Leepak Brislen and father to Blossom and Bunny Brislen, all inhabitants of the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Diamssar was a representative of the Triceratops Society in Port Nyanzaru in Chult during the late 15 century DR. Secretly, he was actually a spy for a group of yuan-ti.
Desha of the Shadows was an elven hunter operating out of Port Nyanzaru in Chult during the late 15 century DR.
Deval was a guard in Freedale during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dimaya was a prodigal under-priestess of Lolth from Sschindylryn during the 15 century DR.
Dia Depthcaria was a half-orc sorcerer of Cormyr during the late 15 century DR.
Diadree was an old woman of Orunn in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dilea Bromath was a paladin of the Silver Flame in the world of Eberron.
Battlemaster Dint was a Purple Dragon of Cormyr, who oversaw the town of Eveningstar during the invasion from Sschindylryn in the late 15 century DR.

Dilyn Mankiller was a warrioress who served as an officer in Tent Town in the human outpost of Ravens Deep in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. She lived in the officers' quarters along with Timur Lendsar, Klarika Livana, Jonas Redmond and Dag Manzo. Dilyn worked for Lord Charles Frederik LaVerne Blacktree IV around the 1370s DR.

Dhellorn Jaszarr was a renowned perfumer in the city of Menzoberranzan in the 14 and 15 centuries DR. Alongside his brother Dirziir the two ran the shop Brothers Jaszarr and were renowned together as the city's "Perfumers to Nobles", the finest purveyors of perfume in the whole city.
Digward Bruck was an adventurer and a mercenary from the city of Ravens Bluff in the late 14 century DR.
Dethra Brathcandle was a woman skilled in herbalism to some extent who lived in the city of Waterdeep in the late 15 and early 16 century DR.
Desperate Wolf was a resident of the city of Ravens Bluff in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dintheron Bleth was a member of the Bleth noble house of Cormyr.

Dharva Scatterheart was the would-be-queen of Greenfields in 1372 DR. She enjoyed the open space, freedom from taxation, and the caravans that regularly pass through. Allied with the Shadow Thieves, Dharva had established a small town called Greenest on the trail that led to Berdusk. She was not particularly happy to be in business with the likes of them, but tolerated it nonetheless.
Dolerphus Thongolir IV was a member of the Thongolir noble family of Waterdeep in the mid–14 century DR.
Donnia Soldou was a drow assassin and a member of a band of four, including Ad'non Kareese, Kaer'lic Suun Wett and Tos'un Armgo.
Djaffar, or Djassar, was the leader of the Hammers, the Marchion of Mirabar's personal defence.
Dolor was a female drow cleric of Eilistraee who lived in the High Forest.
Dora Leen is a chambermaid of The Old Skull Inn in Shadowdale.
Domincus was an Amnian bishop of Helm in the mid-14 century DR and a member of Cordell's Maztican expedition in the .
Don Vaez was an adventurer who led Amn's second expedition to Maztica.

Dorgar Adarbrent was an old Waterdavian noble of the Adarbrent family with a strong interest in preserving Waterdeep's traditions. He gave monetary support to old nobles who were down on their luck. Dorgar was often seen wandering the paths in the City of the Dead.

Donnola Topolino was the granddaughter of Pericolo Topolino, the Grandfather of Assassins in Delthuntle, Aglarond. She served as one of the captains of Morada Topolino (the house of Topolino), along with the mage Wigglefingers.
Doquaio Baenre was the second-boy of Matron Mother Yvonnel Baenre at the time of Jarlaxle Baenre's birth.
Master Djalfi was a Red Wizard of Thay and an instructor of the Academy of Shapers and Binders.

Dog Perry was the assassin in the employ of the thieves guild of Quentin Bodeau in 1364. He was a brutal and savage man. When Artemis Entreri came back to Calimport, Perry against all reasons thought to gain great glory by killing the elder assassin. Unfortunately for Perry, Enteri was more deadly than him and Enteri slew Dog Perry.
Dondago Bloodyfist was a dwarf of the Wilddwarf Brigade in the late 15th century DR.

King Dorglor was the eleventh Obarskyr monarch and a king of Cormyr. He was born in the Year of the Quirt, 110 DR, the second son of Sacrast Obarskyr and began his rule after the death of this brother Daravvan in the Year of the Biting Frost, 124 DR. His reign ended when he took his own life in the Year of the Impassable Chasm, 134 DR.
Doril Cire () was a member of the Cult of the Eternal Flame in Mulmaster in 1491 DR.
Ditriv Starkdale was a sage at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the late 15th century DR.
Diyah al-Wasil was an inhabitant of Huzuz, the City of Delights, in 1367 DR.

Dorgafal Shiverock was a gnome bard and agent of the Guardians of the Weave as of the year 1374 DR. He took on many responsibilites within the organization, serving as both their lorekeeper and judicious interviewer.
Doin Sanehiro, known also as the Monkey, was a shukenja in Kozakura in 1358 DR.
Dorig was a two-headed troll in the High Moor circa 1363 DR.
Dongzhei Nangpo was the leader of the Yellow Mountain Sect in Manass in 1367 DR.
Dlorna Roaryl was the princess of Eskorn, Laerakond, as of 1479 DR. She was a member of the Roaryl dynasty.

The dohwar, sometimes called dowhar, were a race of short, flightless avians. A merchant race, they considered themselves the great rivals of the Arcane, although the Arcane themselves barely acknowledged their existence.
Domiel (), the Mercy-Bringer, was a member of the Celestial Hebdomad and ruler of Mercuria, the Golden Heaven of Mount Celestia. His symbol was the ox.
Donstable Hroun was the Master Merchant of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast. Donstable wrote the book A Merchant's Musings in 1355 DR.

Djarrus Gost was a nobleman of House Gost in the city of Waterdeep during the 14 century DR. He also served as the silent patron of the Foes of the Fang, an adventuring company dedicated to the eradication of vampires within the civilization of the North.

Dorgon "Stonecloak" Haemiiolothtar was the magister of Mystra during the 2 and 3 centuries DR, having enjoyed the longest tenure since the mortal Azuth. He served this post from the Year of the Troublesome Vixen, 177 DR to the Year of the Hippogriff's Folly, 241 DR.
Divine Simfray was a matron mother in the early 11 century DR.
Donder Cormaeril was Lord of House Cormaeril in Cormyr around the turn of the 13-century DR.
Dorlas was a dwarf warrior of the Sons of Baltar in the Iron Mountains, and a companion of Sunbright Steelshanks.
Dolgrims were a kind of aberration native to Eberron. They were created, reportedly through combining pairs of goblins, by the daelkyr.
Dobin Noreth was a member of the Stone-Cold Reavers, a group of reckless adventurers who made their living sometimes as sellswords and sometimes as brigands.
Doomspinner spiders were a type of monstrously sized spider that emerged in the Realms following the Spellplague.
Djalice was a famous priestess of Sune, the Goddess of Beauty.
Nails of the Lady Dlatha Faenar was the high priestess within the Spires Against the Stars, a temple devoted to Beshaba located in Tethyr in the mid-to-late-14 century DR.
Donlevy BelMaris, known as Donlevy the Old, was the 18 Baron of Polten in Damara.
Donlevy BelMaris, known as Donlevy the Young, was the 20 Baron of Polten in Damara. He was named for his father, Donlevy the Old.
Doka'zar was a writer in Kara-Tur known for literary masterpieces. Some of Doka'zar's masterworks were kept in the libraries of Pokarr Gompa in Tabot by .

Saint Dobla was a saint of the Church of Ilmater. She was considered to be the patron Ilmatari saint of both St. Dobla's Abbey and of all women in Calimshan who suffered under oppression in that nation.
Brother Dolmas was a Tethyrian Ilmatari priest living in the Hook Ward of Calimport in the late 14 century DR.
Dolare was a priestess of Mystra active in the Thayan city of Bezantur in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dorlan Nyrotha was Thoster's first mate aboard the Green Siren during the late 14 century DR.
Doisin Kivna was a gnome member of the Silver Sails Trading Company of Neverwinter in the late 14 century DR.

Dlukasz Phorndyl was the proprietor of the Northshield House inn in Triboar in the Dessarin Valley in the late 14 century DR. He was running the inn by 1365 DR and it remained in the Phorndyl family for over a century.
Dora Stonethrow was a dwarf barmaid inhabiting the city of Zhentil Keep during the mid–14 century DR.
Donar Heremet was a thief inhabiting the city of Waterdeep during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Disir were unsightly slime-covered creatures found in the subterranean depths of Underdark's overpopulated areas, led by a disir queen.

Doraven Mirandor was one of earliest kings of Impiltur and the 16 monarch of the Mirandor Dynasty. His reign lasted a mere three years during the 2 century DR. He was known throughout history as Doraven the Bloody.
Lord Donovan Lightfinger was a wealthy aristocrat in Waterdeep and the original patriarch of the wealthy Lightfinger family.
Djassar was a warrior of Mirabar during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Donovan was a sailor and fisher from the town of Targos who lived sometime before the early 14 century DR.
Donzo Shadowkisser was a halfling rogue who worked with the Stag Runners adventurers in the late 14 century DR.
Dom was the baker at Thistleflame Manor and servant of Lord Partic Thistle circa 1369 DR.
Dorenn was a human rogue and adventurer of the Puppetmasters company circa 1369 DR. He was notable among them for being the only one who had actually been a puppeteer in his earlier life.
Dlueae Sharshyndree was one of the eight members of the First Zulkirate, the first female zulkir, and the Zulkir of Evocation in 11 century DR.
Doni was a tiefling child who was among those outcast from the city of Elturel in the late 15 century DR.
Don Juan Montery was an infamous adventuring knight of the Golden Rooster order from the city of Ravens Bluff, active in the late 14 century DR.

Dominique, later known as Lady Dominique Thorin, was a boisterous elf commoner from the city of Ravens Bluff, who married into nobility after accepting the hand of Lord Alexander "Fireball" Thorin in the late 14 century DR.
Dolci was a Netherese arcanist who taught at the Inventor's Conservatory in Karsus's enclave of Eileanar until its destruction in .

Doris was a barmaid in the city of Ravens Bluff in the 14 century DR who originated from the world of Oerth. She had a content life working at The Shark Fin, but fancied the notion of someday joining an adventuring company so she could explore the wider world of Toril.
Dizby was a sailor and the quartermaster aboard the Lustrous Lass in the late 15 century DR.
Djingo was a merchant from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in late 15 century DR.
Dolan was a no-good trapper, brother to Doogal and Digby, from the town of Lonelywood in Icewind Dale in the late 13 century DR.
Doogal was a no-good trapper, brother to Dolan and Digby, from the town of Lonelywood in Icewind Dale in the late 13 century DR.
Fist Discoria was a member of the Flaming Fist mercenary company from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Don't-Call-Me-Runt was a member of the Guild from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.

Dorimara was the daughter of Bubbles Tefoco and granddaughter of Oliver Tefoco, the proprietor of the Beehive Goods and Wares general store in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Dorikel was an Adept of the Absolute, stationed in the Moonrise Towers during the late 15 century DR.
Dolan Cymrych was High King of the Moonshae Isles for a brief time in the mid–9 century DR.
Doriak of the Shells was a dwarven hunter operating out of Port Nyanzaru in Chult during the late 15 century DR.

Doddernick was the finance minister of Graubünden in the Whamite Isles. He represented Graubünden in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .
Dor Amberglow was a human adventurer active in the 14 century DR.
Dlamaerztus was a Red Wizard of Thay in the mid-14 century DR.
Dlartarnan of Belanchor was a warrior and adventurer in the Brave Blades during the early-to-mid 3 century DR.
Dolthin was a Shadovar soldier turned mercenary archer, who ended up working for the mercenary leader Dom in Cormyr during the mid-1480s DR.
Doreta was a young woman from Ravens Bluff in the mid-to-late 14 century DR, who was taken by the vampire Romanisk Vlaensk for companionship.
Donalbain was the founder of the bardic college at Broadleaf Lodge during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Donald Mac Innis was king of Langmuir on the island of Moray in the Moonshae Isles during the late 15 century DR.

Donal Ethen was a sage and wizard of Silverymoon, as well as its sixth mayor. He was well-liked among the Silvaeren even before taking office, and his tenure notably concluded with a voluntary retirement—an uncommon distinction shared by only two other mayors in the town’s history. He was also known as the Wise Bear, a sobriquet referring to his broad-shouldered frame and solid build.

Dlaarvos Fyredram () was a handsome, half-elven repairer in the Luruaran city of Silverymoon. Though relatively popular—especially with older Silvaeren women—he had also been a long-term spy for the Cult of the Dragon by the late 15 century DR, serving as a low-ranking watcher for his contacts in the organization.
Matriarch Donya Silver was the matriarch of the Silver house of half-elves around 1368 DR, residing at Silverhall, the family home in Velprintalar, Aglarond. She was a personal friend to the Simbul.

Dove Falconhand, born Ambara Dove Silverhand, was a ranger, Chosen of Mystra, and one of the Seven Sisters, known for her skill at arms. Most folk in the Realms knew her as a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor who was skilled with bow and sword, but who said little. Fellow Harpers knew her as an accomplished singer and harpist, and also knew she had been raising her son, Azalar Falconhand, in Evermeet. Azalar's father (Dove's husband) was Florin Falconhand of the aforementioned Knights.

Dounalis Guff was the High Priest of Tempus at the Vault of Swords in Hillsfar. He also served as the chaplain for the city's military force, the Red Plumes. A gruff and loud man in his mid-forties by 1374 DR, Dounalis believed that salvation from cowardice could only be found through death on the battlefield.
Dorna Trapspringer was a female dwarf cleric and rogue. She was one of Drogan Droganson's first apprentices in the late 14 century DR.

Doust Sulwood () was a human cleric of Tymora and a member of the Knights of Myth Drannor. He became the Lord of Shadowdale after Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun offered this title to his companion Florin Falconhand but Florin declined it.
Doum'wielle Armgo was the daughter of Sinnafain, an elf in the Moonwood, and Tos'un Armgo, a renegade drow.
Dradeel was an elven wizard and the only surviving member of the explorer Balduran's last crew.

Dorothea Linkletter (née Nacht), was a female human living in Neverwinter around 1479 DR, serving as one of the architects of Lord Dagult Neverember before she became involved in the plots of Rhazzad.
Doxon was a member of the Shadow Thieves in Athkatla around 1370 DR.
Dowell Harpell was a member of the Harpell family and their spokesman in the late 15th century DR. He also served as Longsaddle's representative on the council of the Lords' Alliance.
Doughty was a knight of the Knights in Silver in the late 15th century DR.
Dornal Whitebeard was an agent of the Lords' Alliance in the Moonsea in 1489 DR.
Dracil was a dwarf who lived within the Forest of Amtar in Dambrath.
Dottee was a teamster's wife in Hillsfar in the Moonsea in the late 15 century DR.
Dracandros of the Crimson was an exiled Red Wizard of Thay in Battledale in 1357 DR.
Draac Xorlarrin was a member of House Xorlarrin and an ally of the fire giant Duke Zalto sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
Draevyn Thornbolt was an albino wizard in Neverwinter sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
Draak was one of the lieutenants of the Xanathar Thieves' Guild in Skullport in 1479 DR.
Dornig Leiyraghon was the Lord of House Leiyraghon and one of the seven councilors that ruled Melvaunt in 1374 DR.
Dorn Crownshield was a dwarf mercenary in Melvaunt in 1374 DR.
Drag was the leader of a raiding party of hobgoblins in 1369 DR. They operated out of a base in the abandoned Dwarven kingdom of Tethyamar in the Desertsmouth Mountains.
Dornyn Malaunger was one of nine founding members of the Great Goblet criminal mercantile organization, circa the Year of the Tankard, 1370 DR.
Dougan Dubrace was the founder of the settlement of Dougan's Hole, one of the Ten Towns of Icewind Dale.
Dracohar were humanoid creatures resembling humans with the heads of red dragons. They inhabited several mountains of West and interior Faerûn.
Dorthy Winters was the daughter of Beartrid Winters and Kalas Winters, who worked at the Wolf's Pelt Inn in the Icewind Dale community of Targos circa 1369 DR.
Dragomira Var () was a human gladiator that worked as a spy for the Zhentarim in the late 15 century DR.

Dovo was an inhabitant of the town of Ghars in Cormyr in the mid–14 century DR. He was an assistant to blacksmith Aunsible Durn and notably was revealed to be posing as the ghost of the bandit chieftain Fastred as part of a spy ring.
Dragon eels were massive aquatic creatures related to dragons.
Dowagu were a race of wicked creatures that served Raja Ambuchar Devayam in the Hordelands.
Douglas was an apprentice to Booter, Shadow Thieves' "official torturer" in Athkatla in the late 14 century DR.
King Dornak Torlath "the Puppet King" was the final Amnian monarch of the Torlath dynasty.
Dornar Steelsar was a man of Silverymoon who married into the Amnian Parhek dynasty in the late 13 century DR.

Duke Drac D'Ula was a political figure from Graubünden in the Whamite Isles. Drac represented Graubünden in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .
Draevin Flarwood was a trader from Silverymoon in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. He was a suspect in the murder of Garthin Muirtree.
Dorotee Leachlung was a sea hag member of the Kraken Society and a member of the Sisters of Fury coven that aided the shaman Iceblood in his crusade against the Ten Towns in the late 14 century DR.
Douver was a half-elf bard and member of the Three Coins Fellowship, an adventuring company active in the Delimbiyr Vale in the late 14 century DR, alongside Kars and Eman.
Dowin Grimaxe was a building inspector in the city of Ravens Bluff, and a member of its Builders' Guild, in the 14 century DR.
Draezen Direhand was a monk and the archimandrite of the Dark Ravens' Monastery in the Cloud Peaks of Amn in late 14 century DR.
Dragon turtles were aquatic creatures that were related to dragons. They were considered among the most dangerous aquatic creatures in existence and were even worshiped by some.
